The '''Spirva sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Cyphar/Legends|Cyphar]], [[Derricon]], [[Haurgab]], [[Krykas V]], [[Lopor Station]], [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]] and the capital [[Lenthalis]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Shinda]].
